paper.title: High-Throughput in vivo and in vitro screening of lipid nanoparticles for nucleic acid delivery to the brain
paper.identity_source: Europe PMC REST core record for EXT_ID:41138890, retrieved 2026-11-10; first author confirmed independently against api.crossref.org/works/<doi> (given 'Marco Tullio', family 'Rodrigues Alves', sequence 'first').

licence.article: NOT open access. Europe PMC core record: isOpenAccess = N, license = null, inEPMC = N, inPMC = N, subsetName = null, hasSuppl = N; fullTextUrlList carries exactly one entry, availability 'Subscription required'. Crossref lists only Elsevier TDM user licence (elsevier.com/tdm/userlicense/1.0) and STM article-sharing policies 017/037/012/029/004. NO Creative Commons licence of any kind.
licence.verdict: FAILS CLAUDE.md section 8 (needs CC0/CC-BY-compatible). Recorded off the Europe PMC record, not the publisher landing page, per the brief.

tiers.evidence: Probed the Elsevier CDN route https://ars.els-cdn.com/content/image/1-s2.0-S0378517325011159-mmc<N>.<ext> for N in 1..5 and ext in {pdf,xlsx,docx,zip,csv,txt} -- 30 requests. Exactly ONE returned HTTP 200: mmc1.docx, 7,825,773 bytes, magic 504b0304. All 29 others returned HTTP 404 with a 189-byte XML error body (magic 3c3f786d = '<?xml ve'), which is why the judgement is by magic bytes AND size, not by size alone. There is no Source Data workbook.

tiers.status: USED -- and it is a VECTOR TEXT LAYER, not pixels
tiers.route: DOI -> api.crossref.org/works/10.1016/j.ijpharm.2025.126278 -> alternative-id S0378517325011159 (the PII) -> ars.els-cdn.com content/image route. Anonymous, no session, no login.
tiers.attestation: md5 and sha256 recomputed in this session from the bytes on disk. The file's own word/document.xml names this paper's full title, its 13-author list and the corresponding address ppiresgo@reitoria.ufmg.br -- content only this paper's SI can produce (F-065).
tiers.what_is_in_it: Captions for Figures S1-S13 and Tables S1-S3 as real Word paragraphs; 1 real <w:tbl> (Table S4, 156 rows x ~6 cols of pairwise statistics); 17 EMF images. CRITICAL: Tables S1, S2 and S3 are NOT Word tables -- they are EMF images (word/media/image15,16,17.emf). A <w:tbl> count alone reports ONE table for a document holding four.
tiers.why_not_pixels: The EMFs are Windows metafiles, not bitmaps. image15.emf holds 694 EMR_EXTTEXTOUTW records, image17.emf 534, image16.emf 1571 -- one Unicode glyph per record with an exact device-space reference point. Table S1 and Table S3 were reassembled from those glyph records by clustering on y (23 and 15 distinct rows) and splitting on an x gap, so every digit is a transcription, not a measurement. This is tier 4-equivalent precision reached from a tier-2 container.

tiers.status: NULL RESULT, SEARCHED AND REPORTED EXPLICITLY
evidence: provenance/tools/find_repo.py run TWICE, for the first author ('Rodrigues Alves') and for the PI ('Guimaraes'), each with --doi and --pmid. The DOI code search returned n=1 and the PMID code search n=20; every hit is a digit-string coincidence (the top candidate is RRZE-HPC/BBP-ECM-RA, an HPC cache-benchmark repo whose results/.../caches.txt files contain the numeral run). No repository belongs to this paper.

Regex sweep for GSE\d+ | SRP\d+ | PRJNA\d+ | SRX\d+ | SRR\d+ | SRA | accession | deposit | github | zenodo | dryad | figshare | osf.io | mendeley | 'supplementary data' | 'data availab' over 1,002,901 characters in 3 sources (docx paragraph text 6,382 chars; all EMF text records 19,724 chars; raw word/document.xml 976,795 chars). HITS: 0.

NCBI elink dbfrom=pubmed db=pmc id=41138890 returns ONLY linkname 'pubmed_pmc_refs' (2 citing PMCIDs). There is NO 'pubmed_pmc' SELF-link, so no PMC deposit exists and pmc_fetch.py has nothing to fetch. Europe PMC /supplementaryFiles is per-PMCID and there is no PMCID.
tiers.note: The paper's NGS barcode data would be the one thing an accession could carry, and there is none. That matters only for the biodistribution arm, which is not corpus-admissible anyway.

tiers.evidence: The article PDF is behind Elsevier subscription (Europe PMC availabilityCode S). No paywall or bot-check bypass was attempted. No full text was obtained, so no Methods paragraph, no printed statistic from the body text, and no dose/timepoint sentence is available to this curation.
No PDF was obtained, so there are no page drawings to read. The SI's vector content was read instead, through the EMF record stream (tier 2 above).

tiers.why_tiers_1_to_4_failed: Figure 4G is the ONLY place in the entire paper where the IONIZABLE LIPID varies (LNP4 = C12-200 vs SM-102 vs ALC-0315 at one fixed formulation). Its values appear in no SI table: mmc1.docx's only numeric tables are S1 and S3 (molar composition + size/PDI/zeta/pKa, no transfection values) and S4 (p-values for the b-DNA arm). Tier 1 does not exist (30 probes, 29 x HTTP 404). Tier 3 does not exist (two find_repo runs, 0 accession hits in 1,002,901 chars). Tier 4 is paywalled. So the bar heights exist nowhere but in the published raster.
tiers.resolution_note: A standalone JPEG has no page rectangle, so NO native dpi is derivable (brief section 7) and axis.native_tol was NOT called -- it refuses a guessed dpi and a guess is all that was available. The strict axis.LOO_TOL_PX = 1.5 px gate was used unrescaled; see 07_qc.json for whether it passed on its own.
